question: Val Barker Cup in boxing is given to most outstanding boxer in the Olympics Games but it was NOT awarded in the Olympics Games ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Val Barker Cup:-**

 
 
• **It is a prestigious award given to the most outstanding boxer in the Olympics Games.**
 
• **However, the cup was not awarded in the Olympics Games of 2020.**
 
• The cup was awarded in the previous three Olympics Games of 2016, 2012, and 2008.
 
• The decision to not award the cup in 2020 might have been due to the COVID-19 pandemic and the changes in the schedule and format of the games.
 
• The Val Barker Cup is named after a British sports journalist who covered boxing in the early 1900s and was known for his fair and unbiased reporting.
